_purpose: Single source of truth for every KPI surfaced in README, deck, API demo, and HF Space. tests/test_metrics_manifest.py fails CI if a surface drifts from these values. Update this file FIRST, then the surfaces.
_provenance: All ranking-quality metrics are DEVELOPMENT PROXIES (independent heuristic + LLM-judge labels on dev samples). No official hidden labels were available before submission. Runtime/memory numbers are measured; sources cited per key.

submission._golden_note: 2026-06-14 reasoning de-dup of the HAND pipeline: candidate_id/rank/score byte-identical to the prior fdfd3f35; only the reasoning column changed (distinct verbatim quote per row, 0 repeats in top-100). No reranker; no ranking change.
submission.membership_validated: scripts/validate_submission.py --candidates candidates.jsonl (2026-06-12: all 100 IDs present in pool)

runtime._showpiece_note: apps/api/data/precomputed.json replays the 193.4 s worst-case serial matrix run (runtime_matrix.md row 1); it intentionally shows the conservative figure, not the best one.

dev_proxy_eval._label: dev proxy / LLM-audit — NOT the official hidden score
dev_proxy_eval._composite_note: recomputed on the calibration-free submission (fdfd3f35) vs the same judge labels, coverage 1.00; calibration removal cost ~0.015 composite / dropped NDCG@50 ~0.05, NDCG@10 + P@10 unchanged

reranker_measured_negative._label: LightGBM LambdaMART v2 reranker (codex/ndcg50-killer): measured on the 100K frozen blind set vs the shipped hand pipeline. Rejected; hand pipeline retained. See docs/why_not_reranker.md and docs/measured_negatives.md.
reranker_measured_negative._blind_set: artifacts/h2_availblind_labels.jsonl (generated before any tuning, full population)
reranker_measured_negative._delta: composite -0.0307, NDCG@10 -0.0695, NDCG@50 +0.0135 -- improved @50 but destroyed @10 (50% of the composite). Looked positive only on a curated 249-candidate LLM-judge sample (gpt-4.1-mini +0.027, deepseek +0.085, claude-3.5-haiku +0.019, gemini-3.1-flash-lite +0.049 composite); none generalized to the 100K blind set.
